title: Central Processing Unit (CPU) Architecture
overview: A focused revision guide to central processing unit (cpu) architecture.

sections.title: Von Neumann architecture
content: A single memory stores both data and instructions. Key buses: address bus (memory locations, one-directional), data bus (data/instructions, bi-directional), control bus (control signals).

sections.title: Fetch–decode–execute cycle
content: 1. Address in the PC copies to the MAR; PC increments. 2. Instruction at that address fetched into the MDR, then copied to the CIR. 3. Decoded and executed, using the ACC for arithmetic where needed.

examTips: Register-transfer notation questions want exact register abbreviations (PC, MAR, MDR, CIR, ACC) in the correct order — learn the cycle as a numbered sequence.
